description: This file defines the MCPRequestHandler class responsible for processing MCP (Multi-Cloud Platform) requests, including authentication, header parsing, server configuration, and permission checks within a FastAPI/Starlette-based application.

classes.name: MCPRequestHandler
classes.description: A handler class for processing MCP requests, including authentication, header parsing, server configuration, and permission management.

methods.name: process_mcp_request
methods.description: Asynchronously processes and validates MCP request headers from the ASGI scope, returning authentication info, headers, and configuration data.

methods.name: _get_mcp_auth_header_from_headers
methods.description: Retrieves the deprecated MCP auth header from request headers, with a warning if used.

methods.name: _get_mcp_server_auth_headers_from_headers
methods.description: Parses server-specific MCP authentication headers from request headers.

methods.name: _get_oauth2_headers_from_headers
methods.description: Extracts OAuth2 authorization headers from request headers.

methods.name: _get_mcp_client_side_auth_header_name
methods.description: Determines the header name used for passing MCP auth to downstream servers, configurable via secrets or general settings.

methods.name: get_litellm_api_key_from_headers
methods.description: Retrieves the LiteLLM API key from headers, checking primary and secondary headers.

methods.name: _safe_get_headers_from_scope
methods.description: Safely extracts headers from the ASGI scope, handling decoding and errors.

methods.name: get_allowed_mcp_servers
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of MCP servers allowed for the given user or key based on permissions.

methods.name: _get_key_object_permission
methods.description: Fetches the object permission for a user API key, from cache or database.

methods.name: _get_team_object_permission
methods.description: Fetches the object permission for a team, from cache or database.

methods.name: get_allowed_tools_for_server
methods.description: Retrieves allowed tools for a specific server based on key and team permissions.

methods.name: is_tool_allowed_for_server
methods.description: Checks if a specific tool is permitted for a server based on permissions.

methods.name: is_tool_allowed
methods.description: Determines if a tool is allowed for a user/key based on allowed MCP servers.

methods.name: _get_allowed_mcp_servers_for_key
methods.description: Gets MCP servers permitted for a key, combining direct and access group-based permissions.

methods.name: _get_allowed_mcp_servers_for_team
methods.description: Gets MCP servers permitted for a team, combining direct and access group-based permissions.

methods.name: _get_config_server_ids_for_access_groups
methods.description: Helper to find server IDs from config that match given access groups.

methods.name: _get_db_server_ids_for_access_groups
methods.description: Helper to find server IDs from the database matching access groups.

methods.name: _get_mcp_servers_from_access_groups
methods.description: Resolves access groups to MCP server IDs from both config and database.

methods.name: get_mcp_access_groups
methods.description: Retrieves MCP access groups for a user or key based on permissions.

methods.name: _get_mcp_access_groups_for_key
methods.description: Fetches MCP access groups assigned to a key.

methods.name: _get_mcp_access_groups_for_team
methods.description: Fetches MCP access groups assigned to a team.

methods.name: get_mcp_access_groups_from_headers
methods.description: Extracts MCP access groups from request headers.

methods.name: get_mcp_access_groups_from_scope
methods.description: Extracts MCP access groups from an ASGI scope.
